Devon: Heads up — APAC rack-18 (usw-apac1) showing repeated tail latency spikes since 09:12 UTC, coincident with thermal throttling on GPU-3. Affected: two dedicated pools + ~12 shared tenants.
Maya: Any correlated alerts? heatmap?
Devon: Yes, cloud-telemetry shows thermal -> nvlink backoff -> per-token latency climb. Snippet: ```2026-03-23T09:12:23Z WARN gpu[3] temp=92C nvlink_drop=12 tail_p99=1.8s```
allocator-bot: Automated action: initiated gentle-evac to soft-reserve pool-ephemeral-59 for tenants with >10% tail breaches.
Alex: Proposal: implement an "isolation ladder" for noisy neighbor escalation. Rule sketch: sustained p99 > 500ms for 3m && kvcache-evict-rate > 20/s -> move to fractional dedicated slice (configurable TTL). This avoids immediate hard carveouts but isolates noisy workloads before thermal cascades.
Priya: Sounds sensible but we need to model cost. Fractional dedicated slices will bump monthly committed spend if they persist. Can we prefer model-quantized fallbacks or routing to lower-memory variants first? Redwood-Optimize could recommend quantized bin automatically.
Jamie: Short-term ops play: run a 5% canary that redirects top offenders to soft-reserve fractional slices and to quantized model variants if available. Observe error/quality delta on prompt set. If quality drop < 1% and latency improves, widen to 20%.
Maya: Give me the prometheus queries for the canary dashboard so SRE/SDR can watch. Example queries: ```sum(rate(requests_total{region="apac",model!~"quant.*"}[1m])) by (tenant),
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, tenant)),
sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m])) by (tenant)```
Devon: I'll wire those into a temporary Grafana pane and start canary at 09:40 UTC. Also enabling thermal-proactive-drain for the hot host as stopgap.
Priya: Also add a back-off policy: if a tenant cycles in/out >3x in 15m, mark for manual review and pin to dedicated for 24h to avoid churn.
Alex: We'll need a flag in allocator to make the ladder thresholds tunable per-region (APAC has different thermal profile). Suggest config: `isolation_ladder:{p99_threshold_ms:500, eviction_rate:20, persist_minutes:3, backoff_cycles:3}`
allocator-bot: Canary pool created: fractional-dedicated-canary-331. Route rule applied for tenants: tenant_ids=[t-112,t-409,t-777].
Jamie: I'll coordinate with Product to prepare a short user-facing note for affected Dedicated customers in case isolation causes minor capacity reshuffles.
Maya: Postmortem-ish ask: record the thermal trigger + allocation moves. Ping me if the canary expands.
Devon: Starting canary now. ETA for initial telemetry: 10m. Will update thread with p99 delta. :thumbsup:
allocator-bot: Canary metrics stream available at https://grafana.redwood.local/d/isolations/canary-331
Alex: If the canary shows >30% reduction in p99 with <1% quality regress, recommend rolling to region-wide soft-reserve policy and gating cost alerts to finance.
Priya: Agreed. Also run a cost simulation: hourly vs monthly committed delta for persistent slices. I'll drop numbers here in 30m.
Devon: Update @everyone — after 10m we see p99 drop from 1.8s -> 420ms for the canary tenants, kvcache-evictions down ~65%. Expanding to 15% for a wider signal.
Maya: Nice. Keep the thermal-drain automations on. We'll reconvene if host temp doesn't decay in 20m.
Jamie: Filing a short ops note + action items: 1) isolation ladder rollout plan; 2) cost sim from Priya; 3) allocator flag knobs; 4) product comms draft.
Devon: Thanks team. Will leave the canary running and capture traces.
allocator-bot: Canary expansion complete -> 15% traffic. Monitoring thresholds applied.
